scripts.text:
[Rondo]
Mora is such a mysterious place.
You can understand any language.
scripts.translation:
[迴旋曲]
穆拉真是個神秘的地方。
在這裡你能聽懂任何語言。

scripts.text:
[Rondo]
Of course, when we leave this area I won't be able to understand what you say, but I'll be able to remember the conversations we had. And I'll look forward to the day we meet again, here.
scripts.translation:
[迴旋曲]
當然，當我們離開這個區域後，我就聽不懂您說的話了，但我能記得我們之間的對話。我很期待再次在這裡與您相見的那一天。

scripts.text:
[Rondo]
Please tell Kusmi
that if he wants to meet, we can meet any time. There is nothing to worry about.
scripts.translation:
[迴旋曲]
請告訴庫斯米，
如果他想見面，我們隨時都可以。沒什麼好擔心的。

scripts.text:
[Lilitia]
Boo!!!
He broke his promise again!!!
scripts.translation:
[莉莉緹婭]
嚇死我了！！！
他又食言了！！！

scripts.text:
[Lilitia]
He said he'd be here this time for sure!!!
That place is too cold for me to visit!!!!!
My precious leaves will wither there.
scripts.translation:
[莉莉緹婭]
他說這次一定會來的！！！
那個地方太冷了，我不想去！！！！
我珍貴的葉子在那裡會枯萎的。

scripts.text:
[Lilitia]
What? Theodore sent you?
Please tell him that I'm so mad!!
scripts.translation:
[莉莉緹婭]
什麼？是西奧多派你來的？
請告訴他，我氣死了！！

scripts.text:
[Lilitia]
I really hate the cold.
That's why Mora is a lovely place to live.
scripts.translation:
[莉莉緹婭]
我真的討厭寒冷。
所以穆拉是個可愛的居住地。

scripts.text:
[Lilitia]
The leaves are always fresh here. And, the stress about languages just disappears.
scripts.translation:
[莉莉緹婭]
這裡的葉子總是新鮮的。而且，關於語言的煩惱也消失了。

scripts.text:
[Humming]
Oh!
You're here because Pauchon sent you?
scripts.translation:
[哼唱聲]
哦！
你是波雄派你來的？

scripts.text:
[Humming]
It must've been hard for you to get here. I'm impressed.
The Maze of the Hazy Forest~ It fuels my adventurous spirit!
scripts.translation:
[哼唱聲]
來到這裡一定很不容易吧。我很佩服。
迷霧森林迷宮~ 它激發了我的冒險精神！

scripts.text:
[Humming]
If you reach Splendide before me, please tell Pauchon
that I'm going through the Maze of the Hazy Forest.
scripts.translation:
[哼唱聲]
如果你比我先到輝煌領域，請告訴波雄，
我正在穿過迷霧森林迷宮。

scripts.text:
[Humming]
I heard that a crevice crept in between Jotunheim and Midgard, so I wanted to check it out. But I got stuck here.
I was looking forward to seeing a new place.
scripts.translation:
[哼唱聲]
我聽說約頓海姆和米德加爾特之間出現了一道裂縫，所以我想去看看。但我被困在這裡了。
我一直很期待能看看新的地方。

scripts.text:
[Humming]
Are you from Midgard?
What is it like there?
I've always wanted to see a creature called Poring.
scripts.translation:
[哼唱聲]
你是來自米德加爾特的嗎？
那裡是什麼樣的？
我一直很想看看一種叫波利的生物。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
Oh.... Darn.......
I can't go down, and I can't go back. My credibility that I've worked so hard on is just crumbling into dust.
scripts.translation:
[瓊斯]
噢……該死……
我下不去，也回不去。我辛苦建立起來的信譽，就這樣化為烏有了。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
Ah, are you the traveler who came through the Maze of the Hazy Forest from Splendide?
If you plan to go back, can you please deliver this to the Splendide army?
scripts.translation:
[瓊斯]
啊，你是那位從輝煌領域穿過迷霧森林迷宮過來的旅行者嗎？
如果你打算回去，能麻煩你把這個交給輝煌領域的軍隊嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jones]
A person high up requested it, but I can't cross Bifrost.
scripts.translation:
[瓊斯]
是上級要求送的，但我過不了雙層牛肉堡。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
Deliveries to other places have all stopped also. Ah, my credibility is suffering....
scripts.translation:
[瓊斯]
發往其他地方的快遞也都停了。唉，我的信譽受損了……

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[瓊斯]
謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
I'm a bit embarrassed to ask this of a stranger...... Ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[瓊斯]
向陌生人提出這種要求，我有點不好意思……哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Jones]
You have too many kinds of items. Please lighten your load and come back.
scripts.translation:
[瓊斯]
你攜帶的物品種類太多了。請減輕負重後再來。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
You are carrying too much weight. Please lighten your load and come back.
scripts.translation:
[瓊斯]
你攜帶的重量太重了。請減輕負重後再來。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
Please take good care of it.
It's for Daphrer in Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[瓊斯]
請妥善保管。
這是給輝煌領域的達弗雷爾的。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
Please take good care of it.
It's for Daphrer in Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[瓊斯]
請妥善保管。
這是給輝煌領域的達弗雷爾的。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
Thanks to you, the job is well done.
Hehe, I see potential in you as a delivery man.
Interested in the career of delivery?
scripts.translation:
[瓊斯]
多虧了你，任務順利完成。
嘿嘿，我覺得你很有做送貨員的潛力。
對送貨員這個職業感興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jones]
Hehe, I see potential in you as a delivery man.
Interested in the career of delivery?
scripts.translation:
[瓊斯]
嘿嘿，我覺得你很有做送貨員的潛力。
對送貨員這個職業感興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daphrer]
DRHSfhsdfGSDH FGkkmvoifk DFG DFHshfeksmn fgg FDbbd fjnnvk n skncki dfgd F FHdfkdfjkmv
scripts.translation:
[達弗雷爾]
DRHSfhsdfGSDH FGkkmvoifk DFG DFHshfeksmn fgg FDbbd fjnnvk n skncki dfgd F FHdfkdfjkmv

scripts.text:
[Daphrer]
Oh....
I've been waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[達弗雷爾]
噢……
我一直在等你。

scripts.text:
[Daphrer]
This was urgently needed so thank you for bringing it here, I hope I haven't caused you too much trouble..
scripts.translation:
[達弗雷爾]
這東西很急用，謝謝你帶過來。希望沒有給你添太多麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Daphrer]
This is probably too small to be a reward, but please accept this as a sign of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[達弗雷爾]
這作為獎勵可能太微薄了，但請收下，以表我的謝意。

scripts.text:
[Daphrer]
Oh....
So you lost the item on the way.
scripts.translation:
[達弗雷爾]
噢……
看來你在路上把東西弄丟了。

scripts.text:
[Daphrer]
I knew that it was probably a stretch......
Perhaps I've been unrealistic.
But I thank you for your trouble anyway. Please accept this as a sign of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[達弗雷爾]
我就知道這要求可能有點過分……
也許是我太不切實際了。
但還是要謝謝你的辛苦。請收下這個，以表我的謝意。

scripts.text:
[Daphrer]
For me, a drop of water to make a flower blossom is more important than a sword for war.
scripts.translation:
[達弗雷爾]
對我來說，讓花兒綻放的一滴水，比戰爭用的劍更重要。

scripts.text: Set0
scripts.translation: Set0

scripts.text: Set33
scripts.translation: Set33

scripts.text: Set2_0
scripts.translation: Set2_0

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Oh, wait!
There's another thing I'd like you to do.
There's not enough time to go into details...
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
噢，等等！
還有件事想拜託你。
沒時間細說了...

scripts.text: - Cheshire glanced at the guard standing close to you, and leaned close and whispered into your ear.-
scripts.translation: - 柴郡瞥了一眼站在你身邊的衛兵，湊近你的耳邊低聲說道。-

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
You'll find cat caravans in the middle of ^4d4dffKamidal Tunnel^000000.
There is ^4d4dffa marked box among the caravans' goods to the west of the entrance to the Scaraba Hole^000000.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
在^4d4dff卡米達爾隧道^000000的中部，你會看到貓的商隊。
在^4d4dff斯卡勒伯熔岩^000000入口西側的商隊貨物中，有一個標記過的箱子。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
I'd like you to bring it to me.
You'll see where you should bring it by looking at the box.
This is an important matter.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
請把它帶給我。
看箱子上的標記，你就知道該送到哪裡了。
這件事很重要。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
I have something to get done in advance...
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
我還有些事要提前處理...
祝你好運！

scripts.text: - You have too many items to do this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品欄太滿了，無法執行此任務。 -

scripts.text:
Boxes with all kinds of goods in them are stacked to the ceiling.
The marked box Cheshire was talking about doesn't seem to be here yet.
scripts.translation:
堆滿了各種貨物的箱子一直堆到了天花板。
柴郡提到的那個標記過的箱子似乎還不在這裡。

scripts.text:
Boxes with all kinds of goods in them are stacked to the ceiling.
Looking closely, you find a box with a small piece of paper stuck to it.
You've found the box of goods Cheshire was talking about.
scripts.translation:
堆滿了各種貨物的箱子一直堆到了天花板。
仔細檢視後，你發現了一個貼著紙條的箱子。
你找到了柴郡提到的那個貨物箱。

scripts.text: Move the box.
scripts.translation: 移動箱子

scripts.text: Give up.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text: You promised to take the box of Bradium to Cheshire, who will be waiting for you near the Crevice of Bifrost.
scripts.translation: 你答應將裝有魔力之石的箱子帶給柴郡，他會在雙層牛肉堡裂縫附近等你。

scripts.text:
You decided to give up delivering the box.
You left the box as it is.
scripts.translation:
你決定放棄運送這個箱子。
你原封不動地留下了箱子。

scripts.text:
Boxes with all kinds of goods in them are stacked to the ceiling.
Looking closely, you find a box with a small piece of paper stuck to it.
scripts.translation:
堆滿了各種貨物的箱子一直堆到了天花板。
仔細檢視後，你發現了一個貼著紙條的箱子。

scripts.text: The piece of paper is marked with some mysterious symbol, and below it is written ^4d4dffTo: The Crevice of Bifrost^000000 in small letters.
scripts.translation: 紙條上畫著一些神秘的符號，下面用小字寫著^4d4dff致：雙層牛肉堡裂縫^000000。

scripts.text:
This must the box Cheshire was talking about.
You decide to take it to the location shown on the piece of paper.
scripts.translation:
這一定是柴郡提到的那個箱子。
你決定把它帶到紙條上顯示的地點。

scripts.text:
You've already obtained the box Cheshire was talking about.
Now you only have to take it to the Crevice of Bifrost.
scripts.translation:
你已經拿到了柴郡提到的那個箱子。
現在你只需要把它帶到雙層牛肉堡裂縫即可。

scripts.text: Boxes with all kinds of goods in them are stacked to the ceiling.
scripts.translation: 堆滿了各種貨物的箱子一直堆到了天花板。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to do this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品欄太滿了，無法執行此任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Bring me 20 pieces of refined Bradium.
In exchange for the box, which you carelessly and irresponsibly sold to somebody.
Have I made myself clear?!
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
給我帶來20塊精煉魔力之石。
作為交換，是你那個不小心且不負責任地賣給了別人的箱子。
我說明白了嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
So you've brought it?
The amount is less than it was, but I guess I can't help it.
Next time, you must bring the box to me intact.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
所以你還是帶來了？
數量比原來少了，但我猜也沒辦法。
下次，你必須把箱子完好無損地帶給我。

scripts.text: - Cheshire threw the Bradium into the Crevice. -
scripts.translation: - 柴郡將魔力之石扔進了裂縫裡。-

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
You made a mistake of losing the box, you have to be content with this.
And starting tomorrow, get the box here intact.
Every day.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
你弄丟了箱子，只能接受這個結果了。
從明天開始，把箱子完好無損地帶到這裡。
每天都是。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
You've come at just the right time.
And I see the box is intact!
Well done.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
你來得正是時候。
而且箱子完好無損！
幹得好。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Well, I'll be counting on you, tomorrow as well.
Get it?
Now, leave this place before the Laphines grow suspicious.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
好了，明天也指望你了。
明白嗎？
現在，趁拉芬人還沒起疑心，趕緊離開這裡。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
...Hmm? Huh?
It's {0}!
What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
...嗯？什麼？
是你啊，{0}！
你在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: Huh? Cheshire?
scripts.translation: 什麼？柴郡？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
What makes you so surprised?
Does it surprise you to see me here?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
你驚訝什麼？
在這裡見到我讓你很意外嗎？

scripts.text: Nothing, it's just the hood...
scripts.translation: 沒什麼，只是那個兜帽...

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Oh... This. Because it's bothersome.
And here, I don't have to mind others.
Oh, and well met!
I was going to put you to work when you came to Diel.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
哦...這個。因為戴著太麻煩了。
而且在這裡，我不必在意別人的看法。
啊，幸會！
你來到迪爾的時候，我本來打算讓你幹活的。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
.......What? Why are you staring at me like that?
his is all for Ahat's good.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
......什麼？你為什麼那樣盯著我看？
這一切都是為了阿哈特好。

scripts.text: I guess I have no choice.
scripts.translation: 看來我別無選擇。

scripts.text: I have a lot of things to do!
scripts.translation: 我有很多事要做！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(He will be suspicious if I refuse to do it... I guess I should play along for now.)
Okay.
I'll do anything for Ahat's pleasure.
So, what do you need me for?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(如果我拒絕，他可能會起疑心...我想還是先配合一下吧。)
好吧。
為了阿哈特的愉悅，我什麼都願意做。
那麼，你需要我做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Things to do?
What things?
This is one of the things you must do.
Don't forget you're are loyal to Ahat.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
要做的事？
什麼事？
這就是你必須做的事之一。
別忘了，你是效忠於阿哈特的。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Great! Now I will tell you what to do.
You know there is an entrance to Scaraba Hole in the middle of Kamidal Tunnel?
You will find cat caravans around there who sell supplies and some simple tools.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
很好！現在我來告訴你該做什麼。
你知道卡米達爾隧道中間有一個通往斯卡勒伯熔岩的入口嗎？
在那附近，你會看到一些販賣補給品和簡單工具的貓商隊。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
There is a marked box among the goods stacked there.
I'd like you to bring the box to me.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
在那堆貨物中，有一個標記過的箱子。
我要你把那個箱子帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
It's a simple job of picking up and delivering a box.
Do it ^4d4dff quickly and quietly, without being noticed^000000.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
這只是一個簡單的取送箱子的任務。
^4d4dff要快速且安靜地完成，別被人發現^000000。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Now, move!
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
現在，行動！

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Bring the box from Kamidal Tunnel.
Quickly and quietly!
No, get a move on!
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
把卡米達爾隧道的箱子帶過來。
快速且安靜！
不，快動起來！

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
........That box!
Oh, yes. It's the right one!
You've done a good job.
This is very important.
Ahat will be pleased.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
......那個箱子！
哦，是的，就是那個！
你做得很好。
這非常重要。
阿哈特會很高興的。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
The boxes will be at the same place every day.
I'll leave the job to you.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
箱子每天都會出現在同一個地方。
這件事就交給你了。

scripts.text: Why don't you do it yourself?
scripts.translation: 為什麼你自己不去做？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
........ Hmm...
It's only you humans that have free access to any place.
Plus, this place is Laphine territory.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
......嗯...
只有你們人類可以自由出入任何地方。
而且，這裡是拉芬人的地盤。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
I don't attract their attention much, looking like this,
but what would Saphas think?
To see Ahat's man in a Laphine territory?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
我現在的樣子不太引人注意，
但薩法他們會怎麼想？
看到阿哈特的人出現在拉芬人的地盤上？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
They will grow suspicious.
But you humans are free from such troubles, so that's why you're the right one for the job.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
他們會起疑心的。
不過你們人類沒有這種顧慮，所以你是最合適的人選。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(... I don't buy his story, but he believes I'm on his side, so I guess I should play along.)
What happens to this Bradium, then?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（……我不太相信他的說辭，但他認為我站在他那邊，所以我姑且配合一下吧。）
那這些魔力之石會怎麼處理？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
That thing?
Hand it to me.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
那個？
交給我吧。

scripts.text:
- Cheshire opened the box, checked the Bradium in it, threw them into the Crevice,
and looked back, dusting his hands off, and with a triumphant look on his face. -
scripts.translation:
- 柴郡開啟箱子，檢查了裡面的魔力之石，將它們扔進裂縫，
然後回過頭，拍了拍手上的灰塵，臉上帶著得意的神情。 -

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
This is what happens.
*laugh* Beyond the Crevice lies a path unknown to you.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
就是這樣處理的。
*笑* 裂縫的另一邊，是你們未知的道路。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Well, I'll leave the matter to you.
Try to bring the box to me every day.
Okay?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
好了，這件事就交給你了。
試著每天把箱子帶給我。
好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
In compensation for your efforts, I'll give you an Exploit Certification of Sapha and a little cash.
Now, leave this place before the Laphines grow suspicious.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
作為對你辛勞的補償，我會給你薩法的行動證明和一點現金。
現在，趁拉芬人還沒起疑心，趕緊離開這裡。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Huh? What's up?
You haven't brought the box today?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
咦？怎麼了？
你今天沒帶箱子來？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Hmm, this is unexpected...
Well, I have no choice then.
I'll have another guy do it today.
But you must do it starting tomorrow, okay?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
嗯，這出乎意料……
好吧，我別無選擇。
今天我會讓另一個人去做。
但從明天開始，你必須做到，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
... Huh? I think I've seen you somewhere...
..........Oh!
{0}...?!
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
……咦？我覺得我在哪裡見過你……
..........哦！
{0}...？！
你怎麼來這裡了？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
You say you've forgotten what to do?
You're not supposed to be here.
You're supposed to be at the crevice to the south of Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
你說你忘了要做什麼？
你不應該在這裡。
你應該在迪卡特斯南邊的裂縫那裡。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Whoa.
What was Ahat thinking when he sent such an idiot to me?
Now, get a move on and do your job.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
天哪。
阿哈特在想什麼，竟然派這麼個笨蛋來找我？
現在，趕緊動起來，去做你的工作。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
...Why isn't this fellow showing up?
Should be here by now...
Lost the way back perhaps...?
....? Eh? Who, who are you? How long have you been standing here?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
……這傢伙怎麼還沒來？
應該早就到了……
也許是迷路了……？
....？咦？你，你是誰？你在這裡站了多久了？

scripts.text: A cat?!
scripts.translation: 一隻貓？！

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Who... who's a cat?!
Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
誰……誰是貓？！
滾開！

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Oh, have you been there?
What happened to the box?
Why are you empty-handed?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
哦，你去了那裡？
箱子怎麼樣了？
為什麼你兩手空空？

scripts.text: I'll look for it again!
scripts.translation: 我會再去找找看！

scripts.text: I lost it...
scripts.translation: 我弄丟了……

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Make sure you do a good job!
And keep looking for it.
You must not lose it.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
一定要做好工作！
繼續尋找它。
絕對不能再弄丟了。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Where?
Which merchant did you sell it to?
Can't you distinguish between what to sell and what not to sell?
Were you asleep when you made the deal?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
在哪裡？
你把它賣給了哪個商人？
你連什麼該賣、什麼不該賣都分不清嗎？
做交易的時候你在睡覺嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
This is utterly ridiculous.
Make up for what you lost!
^4d4dff20 pieces of refined Bradium^000000!!!
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
這簡直太荒唐了。
把你弄丟的東西補回來！
^4d4dff20塊精煉魔力之石^000000！！！

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Each day, one of these boxes is sent to Kamidal Tunnel.
It's smuggled in among other items.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
每天，都會有一個這樣的箱子被送往卡米達爾隧道。
它是混在其他貨物裡走私進去的。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Sneak into the place on time, and bring the box to me. The boxes will be at the same place every day.
You'll be doing it every day.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
準時潛入那裡，把箱子帶給我。箱子每天都會出現在同一個地方。
你要每天都這麼做。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
It's about time.
Now go get the box.
It should be lying near the entrance to Scaraba Hole in the Kamidal Tunnel.
You've done this before, so you must be familiar with it?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
時間差不多了。
現在去拿箱子。
它應該就在卡米達爾隧道通往斯卡勒伯熔岩的入口附近。
你以前做過，應該很熟悉吧？

scripts.text:
..........?
You sense someone moving around.
There must be someone down there.
scripts.translation:
..........？
你感覺到有人在附近活動。
下面一定有人。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
...Eh?
What a surprise. What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
...咦？
真是意外。你在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: And what are YOU doing here?
scripts.translation: 那你在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: Those ears...?
scripts.translation: 那對耳朵...？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Out for a walk?
I came out with Ahat, but he went back in to take care of an urgent matter.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
出來散步？
我和阿哈特一起出來的，但他回去處理緊急事務了。

scripts.text: Wha... What a pretty tree.
scripts.translation: 哇...好漂亮的樹。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
This tree... it's white, transparent, and shiny.
It's a Sapha's body.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
這棵樹...它是白色的，透明且閃閃發光。
這是薩法的身體。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
You know Saphas slowly turn to stone throughout their lives.
So when they die, they turn to stony trees.
This forest is... their cemetery, so to speak.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
你知道薩法在生命過程中會慢慢變成石頭。
所以它們死後，就會變成石化的樹。
這片森林...可以說是它們的墓地。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
....... Look closely, and you can make out his arms and legs.
Interesting, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
....... 仔細看，你能分辨出它的手臂和腿。
很有趣，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
... .. ...

[Cheshire]
Oh, this is so annoying.
I'm off!
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
噢，真煩人。
我走了！

scripts.text: - Cheshire stormed off... -
scripts.translation: - 柴郡氣沖沖地離開了... -

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
What? The ears?
Well, it's no wonder because I'm a beastman.
... Why... Why are you staring me like that?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
什麼？耳朵？
畢竟我是獸人，這沒什麼好奇怪的。
... 為什麼... 為什麼你那樣盯著我看？

scripts.text: Are you responsible for the report?!
scripts.translation: 你是負責報告的嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
What are you talking about?
I don't know such a thing!
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
你在說什麼？
我根本不知道那是什麼東西！

scripts.text: - Cheshire ran away... -
scripts.translation: - 柴郡逃跑了... -

scripts.text:
A boy dressed in unusual clothing is standing, with a fierce look in his eyes.
You guess you'd better leave him alone.
scripts.translation:
一個穿著奇裝異服的男孩站在那裡，眼神兇狠。
你最好別惹他。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
You are very delicate.
It's true that I need help,
but I don't think you can help.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
你真是多愁善感。
我確實需要幫助，
但我覺得你幫不上忙。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
I hear you passed through the Hazy Forest.
Did you...
Did you happen to see
Lope, my fiance, there?
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
聽說你經過了迷霧森林。
你... 
你在那裡見過我的未婚夫洛佩嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I did.
scripts.translation: 是的，有。

scripts.text: No, I didn't.
scripts.translation: 不，我沒見過。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
Are you sure? Where did you see him?
Take me there, quick!
...
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
你確定嗎？你在哪裡見過他？
快帶我去！
...

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
What?
You're kidding...?
How could you?
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
什麼？
你在開玩笑...？
你怎麼能這樣？

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
Please find my Lope.
I came here to the Village of Mora
after asking all around,
but there is nothing more I can do.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
請幫我找到洛佩。
我四處打聽後來到了穆拉村，
但我已經無能為力了。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
My heart aches at the thought of Lope...
He will be desperately looking for me...
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
一想到洛佩，我的心就痛...
他一定正在拼命找我...

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy!
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙！

scripts.text: I'll help you!
scripts.translation: 我會幫你的！

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
How heartless!
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
真無情！

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
I heard that he had gone into the Hazy Forest,
while guiding tourists around the village.
One of the tourists who went with Lope
must still be at the inn.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
聽說他帶著遊客在村裡遊覽時，
走進了迷霧森林。
其中一個和洛佩同行的遊客
應該還在旅館裡。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
He wouldn't see me and locked himself in the room.
But he might be willing to see you, because you've been to the Hazy Forest.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
他不願見我，把自己鎖在房間裡。
但既然你去過迷霧森林，他也許會願意見你。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
The tourist is at the inn,
not in front of me!
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
遊客在旅館裡，
不在我面前！

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
So you've seen Pitt!
I knew he would be willing to see you.
What did he say?
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
原來你見過皮特！
我就知道他願意見你。
他說了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
...No way....!
That is utter nonsense.
To blame Lope for it!
I found this piece of paper
near the Hazy Forest.
I'm sure it's Lope's.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
...不可能....！
這完全是胡說八道。
竟然把責任推給洛佩！
我在迷霧森林附近發現了這張紙片。
我確信這是洛佩的。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
If you find the rest of ^0000FFLope's Clues^000000,
you'll be able to find out
where he is.
I'm counting on you, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
如果你找到剩下的^0000FF洛佩之線索^000000，
就能查出他在哪裡。
拜託你了，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
If you come across a ^0000FFLope's Clue^000000, please show it to Pitt.
I hope he will tell the truth soon.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
如果你遇到^0000FF洛佩之線索^000000，請拿給皮特看。
希望他早點說出真相。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
I don't understand it.
I'm now suspicious of his motives.
Why is he trying so hard to accuse Lope?
Wait... those clues...
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
我不明白。
我現在開始懷疑他的動機了。
他為什麼這麼拼命地指控洛佩？
等等...那些線索...

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
Those seem to be more than simple notes.
Can I have a look at them?
...
These fit together like a puzzle.
... Oh!... This is...
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
這些看起來不僅僅是普通的筆記。
能讓我看看嗎？
...
它們像拼圖一樣拼合在一起。
...噢！...這是...

scripts.text:
[Lope's Letter]
...We've been wandering around the Forest for days.
...So we're not protecting the tourists,
I got sick from deadly poison, and became a burden to everyone.
How pathetic...
scripts.translation:
[洛佩的信]
...我們在普勒斯特森林遊蕩了好幾天。
...我們並沒有在保護遊客，
我中了致命猛毒，成了大家的累贅。
真沒用...

scripts.text:
[Lope's Letter]
No wonder I was kicked out of
the Splendide Expedition.
...But I managed to protect at least one tourist.
He will deliver this letter and the ring to you.
scripts.translation:
[洛佩的信]
難怪我被趕出了輝煌領域探險隊。
...但我至少保護了一位遊客。
他會把這封信和戒指交給你。

scripts.text:
[Lope's Letter]
...I wanted to propose to you
as a proud member of the Expedition.
I'm sorry, Euridi.
See you soon.
scripts.translation:
[洛佩的信]
...我想以探險隊成員的身份向你求婚。
對不起，尤里迪。
再見。

scripts.text:
Having read the letter,
Euridi is standing staring blankly like someone who wasn't all there.
Let's go show the letter to Pitt.
scripts.translation:
讀完信後，
尤里迪呆立在那裡，眼神空洞，彷彿魂不守舍。
讓我們把信拿給皮特看吧。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
No, Lope must be safe.
He will come back no matter what...
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
不，洛佩一定沒事。
無論發生什麼，他都會回來的...

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
......

You hear a song coming from the girl who is hanging her head low.
Her friend seems to have something to say.
scripts.translation:
你聽到那個低著頭的女孩正在唱歌。
她的朋友似乎有話要說。

scripts.text:
You hear a quiet singing voice.
You can't make the words out.
scripts.translation:
你聽到微弱的歌聲。
聽不清歌詞。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
Have you found Lope?
Is he safe?
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
你找到洛佩了嗎？
他安全嗎？

scripts.text: Tell her you can't possibly find him.
scripts.translation: 告訴她你根本找不到他

scripts.text: Tell her he is dead.
scripts.translation: 告訴她他已經死了

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
I'll go look for him myself.
Hopefully... it's not too late, yet.
Let me go, there's no time to lose!
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
我要親自去找他。
希望...還來得及。
讓我走，沒時間浪費了！

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
I don't believe it.
He told me he would come back soon...
He told me to hang on.
It can't be... It just can't be...
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
我不相信。
他說過會很快回來的...
他讓我堅持住。
不會的...絕不可能...

scripts.text:
You hand her Lope's Ring, which Pitt gave you.
With the ring in her hand, Euridi bursts into tears.
She starts to sing in a strained voice, still crying.
scripts.translation:
你把皮特給你的洛佩之戒遞給她。
尤里迪握著戒指，失聲痛哭。
她一邊哭，一邊用顫抖的聲音唱起了歌。

scripts.text:
You stand frozen.
You hear a quiet singing voice.
scripts.translation:
你僵在原地。
你聽到微弱的歌聲。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Please stop Euridi.
She is desperate to find her missing fiance.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
請阻止尤里迪。
她為了尋找失蹤的未婚夫已經走投無路了。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Pitt is definitely suspicious.
I think he is avoiding Euridi...
He must be hiding something.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
皮特絕對很可疑。
我覺得他在躲避尤里迪...
他一定在隱瞞什麼。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
To tell the truth, I don't think
that Lope is alive.
I'm just worried about Euridi.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
說實話，我不認為洛佩還活著。
我只是擔心尤里迪。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
Aaarrrggghhh!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
...
To tell the truth, I really believe
that Lope is alive.
...
*sigh*
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
...
說實話，我真的相信
洛佩還活著。
...
*嘆氣*

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
How's Pitt doing?
I think I should go visit him
and make him feel worse!
He's so disgusting!
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
皮特怎麼樣了？
我覺得我應該去拜訪他，
讓他更難受一點！
他真噁心！

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Go to Pitt, quick.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
快去見皮特。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Euridi is singing a song of healing
to protect her weakened body and mind.
At this rate, something's going to happen to her too.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
尤里迪正在唱治癒之歌，
以保護她虛弱的身體和心靈。
照這樣下去，她也會出事的。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Oh, I remember a traveler telling me
that he had seen a suspicious man
near the entrance to the Hazy Forest.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
哦，我記得有個旅行者告訴我，
他在迷霧森林入口附近
看到一個可疑的男子。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
The traveler says he looked creepy standing there staring blankly,
but he couldn't see clearly
because of the thick fog.
I think it's worth investigating.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
旅行者說那人站在那裡發呆，看起來很詭異，
但因為霧氣太濃，
他看不太清楚。
我覺得值得去調查一下。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
I hear that a suspicious man was seen
near the entrance to the Hazy Forest.
The traveler says he looked creepy standing there staring blankly,
but he couldn't see clearly
because of the thick fog.
I think it's worth investigating.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
聽說在迷霧森林入口附近
看到一個可疑的男子。
旅行者說那人站在那裡發呆，看起來很詭異，
但因為霧氣太濃，
他看不太清楚。
我覺得值得去調查一下。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Your face is dark.
Bad news?
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
你臉色很難看。
是壞訊息嗎？

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
There is a Laphine saying that
desperation invites disaster.
Maybe we're responsible
for what happened.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
拉芬族有句諺語說：
絕望會招致災難。
也許我們要為
發生的事負責。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
You have too many things with you.
Can you throw out some of them?
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
你帶的東西太多了。
能扔掉一些嗎？

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Lope will be able to rest in peace now.
Thank you. I won't forget what you've done for me.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
洛佩現在可以安息了。
謝謝你。我不會忘記你為我所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Thank you. I won't forget your help.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
謝謝你。我不會忘記你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
So you're quite good,
since you passed through the Hazy Forest alive.
I'm completely messed up, you see,
so I can't afford to listen to the tales of your exploits.
Now leave.
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
你能活著穿過迷霧森林，
看來你很厲害嘛。
我現在一團糟，
沒心情聽你吹噓你的英勇事蹟。
現在滾。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
You have a knack for pestering people, don't you?
Euridi sent you, eh?
The Laphine couple is
anxious to kill me.
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
你很擅長糾纏別人，不是嗎？
是尤里迪派你來的吧？
那對拉芬族夫婦
想殺了我。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
Go and tell her!
That the stupid guide
pushed us reluctant tourists into the forest,
and ran off to save his own skin!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
去告訴她！
那個愚蠢的嚮導
把我們這些不情願的遊客推進森林，
然後自己逃命去了！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
So you're sorry that it's me, not him, that's here?
He will be alive somewhere,
so go and try to find him! Just stop bothering me!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
所以你是遺憾站在這裡的是我，而不是他？
他肯定還活著在某個地方，
所以去試著找他吧！別再來煩我！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
This is all because of
the stupid guide!
I hate Laphines!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
這都是那個
愚蠢的嚮導的錯！
我討厭拉芬族！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
This is all because of
the stupid guide!
I hate Laphines!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
這都是那個
愚蠢的嚮導的錯！
我討厭拉芬族！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
That thing you have in your hand...
It looks very strange.
I've never seen such a thing before.
You'd better not keep that.
Can I have it?
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
你手裡拿的那個東西...
看起來很奇怪。
我從沒見過這種東西。
你最好別留著它。
能給我嗎？

scripts.text: Give it to him.
scripts.translation: 給他

scripts.text: Don't give it to him.
scripts.translation: 不給他

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
So I swallow it like this,
and voila! Evidence gone!
Now I can sleep soundly, thank you!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
我像這樣把它吞下去，
看！證據消失了！
這下我可以睡個安穩覺了，謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
Why are you showing me such a thing?
I don't know anything! I'm the victim here!
I'm a victim of the schemes of the Laphine couple.
It's unfair...
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
你為什麼要給我看這種東西？
我什麼都不知道！我才是受害者！
我是那對拉芬族夫婦陰謀的受害者。
這不公平...

scripts.text:
It's no use trying to talk to him any more.
Try talking to Euridi.
scripts.translation:
再跟他說話也沒用了。
試著去跟尤里迪談談吧。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
This is unfair!
This is so totally unfair!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
這不公平！
這太不公平了！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
What are you, a professional mover?
Stomping about with a ton of stuff on your back!
I can't rest because of the noise!
Throw away all that stuff!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
你是專業的搬運工嗎？
揹著那麼重的東西到處走！
吵得我沒法休息！
把那些東西都扔掉！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
I never imagined you'd find them all
and piece them together.
Is this a divine punishment...?
Or Laphines' curse?
Whew...
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
我沒想到你會把它們都找出來
並拼湊在一起。
這是神的懲罰嗎...？
還是拉芬族的詛咒？
呼...

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
That guide fellow,
he opened the gate out
when he was hit hard
by the poison.
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
那個嚮導，
他在被毒液嚴重擊中時，
打開了外面的門。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
When I was hesitating whether to take him with me,
he handed me that letter and the ring.
Laphines' jewelry...
It's rumored that nobody could ever have it except Laphines,
including the Gods themselves.
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
當我猶豫要不要帶上他時，
他遞給我那封信和戒指。
拉芬族的珠寶...
傳說除了拉芬族，
連神明都無法擁有它。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
So I had in my hands
a treasure among treasures!
How...! Just how on earth
could I have let it pass through!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
所以我手裡拿著
珍寶中的珍寶！
天哪...！我到底是怎麼
讓它從我手中溜走的！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
I was going to leave this place
as soon as I pulled myself together.
But now I'm stuck here,
affected by the poison myself.
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
我本來打算一緩過勁就離開這裡。
但現在我被困在這裡，
我自己也中了毒。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
I'll give you the ring back,
so please leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
我把戒指還給你，
求你別再糾纏我了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then where could Lope...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那洛佩會在哪裡呢...

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
If he died near the exit of the forest,
he must be somewhere around there,
in whatever form he might be in.
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
如果他死在普勒斯特森林的出口附近，
他應該就在那一帶，
無論他變成了什麼樣子。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
I'm a victim, too!
So leave me alone! I beg you!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
我也是受害者！
所以別管我了！求你了！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
...

He's sleeping.
He seems to be in a very deep sleep.
scripts.translation:
他在睡覺。
他似乎睡得很沉。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
......

[Suspicious Man]
Aaaarrrrrggggghhhh!!!!!!
I can't see anything.
Who's there?
Answer, or I'll take you as an enemy and kill you.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
啊啊啊啊啊！！！！
我什麼都看不見。
誰在那裡？
回答我，否則我就把你當敵人殺掉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Euridi is looking for you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
尤里迪在找你。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
......

[Lope]
Wraith, how can you be so harsh to me?
I asked you to wipe the name off my mind
in return for bearing the curse!
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
惡靈，你怎麼能對我這麼苛刻？
我讓你抹去我腦海中的名字，
作為回報，我承擔了詛咒！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Will you please calm down and listen to...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
請冷靜下來，聽我說...

scripts.text:
[Lope]
My desire to help
led me to my death,
And my desire to survive and take revenge
led me to my rebirth.
I will not side with life any more.
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
我渴望幫助他人，
卻因此走向死亡；
我渴望生存並復仇，
才得以重生。
我不再站在生命這一邊了。

scripts.text:
[Lope]
As soon as my transformation is over,
I will punish you all with the bloody confusion of the Hazy Forest,
which saved my life!
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
等我完成變身，
我將用迷霧森林那救過我一命的
血腥混亂來懲罰你們所有人！

scripts.text: You put the letter Euridi pieced together in Lope's hands.
scripts.translation: 你將尤里迪拼湊好的信件遞到了洛佩手中。

scripts.text:
[Lope]
...This is!
I feel Euridi's touch.
So the letter... was delivered to Euridi?
This is unbelievable...
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
...這是！
我感受到了尤里迪的觸碰。
所以這封信...是寄給尤里迪的嗎？
這簡直難以置信...

scripts.text:
[Lope]
Deformed as I am now,
I'm not her love any more.
Go back, and tell her that Lope turned to dust
on the ground of the Hazy Forest long ago.
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
如今我面目全非，
已不再是她所愛的人。
回去吧，告訴她，洛佩早已化作塵土，
消散在迷霧森林的地上了。

scripts.text:
[Lope]
Now go!
This is my last request as a Laphine called Lope...
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
現在快走吧！
這是我作為拉芬族洛佩最後的請求...

scripts.text:
[Lope]
Deformed as I am now,
I'm not her love any more.
Go back, and tell her that Lope turned to dust
on the ground of the Hazy Forest long ago.
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
如今我面目全非，
已不再是她所愛的人。
回去吧，告訴她，洛佩早已化作塵土，
消散在迷霧森林的地上了。

scripts.text:
[Lope]
Now go!
This is my last request as a Laphine called Lope...
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
現在快走吧！
這是我作為拉芬族洛佩最後的請求...

scripts.text: You see a ring glowing faintly on his left hand.
scripts.translation: 你看到他左手上有一枚微微發光的戒指。

scripts.text: I see a suspicious man. Should I try talking to him?
scripts.translation: 我看到一個可疑的男子。要不要試著和他談談？

scripts.text: Leave him alone.
scripts.translation: 別管他

scripts.text: Talk to him.
scripts.translation: 和他談談。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
......

[Suspicious Man]
.
...
........!!!

[Suspicious Man]
Aaaaarrrrrggghh!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
啊啊啊啊啊！！！！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
......

^FF0000- Warning message -
- Hang on there!! -
- You have too many items -
- to receive any more items. -
- Please lighten your load -
- and try again. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^FF0000- 警告資訊 -
- 堅持住！！ -
- 您的物品欄已滿 -
- 無法接收更多物品。 -
- 請減輕負重 -
- 然後重試。 -^000000

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Don't humans sleep?
People should be sleeping at this hour.
Why on earth are you bothering me?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
人類不睡覺的嗎？
這個點應該都在睡覺了。
你們到底為什麼要來打擾我？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I can't get any sleep because of you.
I have to sleep for my research tomorrow.
You should go sleep too.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
因為你們，我根本睡不著。
我明天還要做研究，必須睡覺。
你們也該去睡覺了。

scripts.text: Z z Z z
scripts.translation: Z z Z z

scripts.text: ^FF0000He appears to be asleep.^000000

[Raffle Researcher]
Oh no~ My research tools...
What...... What was it?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
哎呀~ 我的研究工具...
那...那是什麼來著？

scripts.text: What is your business here?
scripts.translation: 你來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Hmm?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
嗯？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You're human...? Are you human...?
You... came from the underworld?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你是人類...？你是人類...？
你...是從冥界來的？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Human beings are incredible...
You survived the crevice and made it here.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
人類真是不可思議...
你竟然從裂縫中倖存下來，並來到了這裡。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
... ... ...

[Raffle Researcher]
You, come here for a minute.
It's a simple experiment, so there's no need to be afraid.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你，過來一下。
這只是個簡單的實驗，不用害怕。

scripts.text: What a crazy Raffle. I must run away.
scripts.translation: 這個拉弗爾太瘋狂了。我得趕緊逃跑。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You said you had made it up from the Crevice,
so I was wondering what race you were,
but a mere human? How did you get up here?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你說你是從裂縫裡爬上來的，
所以我很好奇你是什麼種族，
結果只是個普通人類？你是怎麼上來的？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
What... I thought a human who made it up from the Crevice
would be extraordinary,
but you're no more than a kid.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
什麼... 我以為能從裂縫裡爬上來的人類一定很特別，
結果你不過是個小孩。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Go hunt more ^000000Porings^000000
and come back when your level is in the triple digits kid!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
去多打幾隻^000000波利^000000，
等你等級達到三位數再回來，小孩！

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
... ... ...

[Raffle Researcher]
You... You're not like the other humans.
You're not running away...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你... 你和其他人類不一樣。
你沒有逃跑...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You've got some serious guts...
Now I really want to do some experiments on you...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你膽子真大...
我現在更想在你身上做實驗了...

scripts.text: Well... that's... um...

[Raffle Researcher]
Ha ha... Just kidding...
I'm a Raffle researcher,
but I don't research humans.
Actually, I have no idea
what to research
about humans...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
哈哈... 開玩笑的...
我是拉弗爾研究員，
但我並不研究人類。
實際上，我完全不知道
該研究人類什麼...

scripts.text: Glad to hear that...
scripts.translation: 聽到這個就放心了...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
That's that. You're not busy, are you?
I'd like you to give me a hand...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
那個。你不是很忙吧？
我想請你幫個忙...

scripts.text: Help him.
scripts.translation: 幫助他。

scripts.text: Help willingly.
scripts.translation: 樂意幫忙。

scripts.text: Although you feel a little embarrassed, help anyhow.
scripts.translation: 雖然有點尷尬，但還是幫忙吧。

scripts.text: Help with conviction.
scripts.translation: 堅定地幫忙。

scripts.text: Help adorably.
scripts.translation: 可愛地幫忙。

scripts.text: You're suspicious, but help anyhow.
scripts.translation: 雖然覺得可疑，但還是幫忙吧。

scripts.text: You have no choice. Help him.
scripts.translation: 別無選擇。幫他吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I haven't met many humans
but you clearly care about
another person's hardship.
You must be an ^FF0000extremely^000000 nice human.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我見過的人類不多，
但你明顯很關心他人的困境。
你一定是個^FF0000非常^000000善良的人類。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'll save my thanks for time's sake.
It's important, so please take care of it quickly.
I can't proceed with the research because of it.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
為了節省時間，我就不多道謝了。
這件事很重要，請快點處理。
因為這件事，我的研究無法繼續了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Here at the Mora Inn,
there's a very famous bath.
If anybody, not just us Raffles,
goes into the bath water
their wounds will be healed instantly...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
在穆拉旅館裡，
有一處非常有名的浴池。
無論是誰，只要不是我們拉弗爾人，
泡進浴池的水裡，
傷口就會瞬間癒合...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
So being a great researcher, I went into the bath
to check it out further
and... unfortunately...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
身為一名優秀的研究員，我走進浴池
想進一步調查一下，
結果...不幸的是...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I was attacked by a mysterious creature,
and I lost consciousness.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我被一隻神秘的生物襲擊了，
然後失去了意識。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
When I woke up, I realized that
my important research tools were missing...
So I was at a loss for what to do.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
等我醒來時，發現
我重要的研究工具不見了...
當時我真是不知所措。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
And here you are, a human,
a brave, heroic human that arrived at Mora Village from the Crevice.
Your willingness to help has really taken this load off of my mind.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
然後你就來了，一個人類，
一個從裂縫來到穆拉村莊的、勇敢而英勇的人類。
你願意幫忙，真的讓我如釋重負。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Please go to the bath house and retrieve my research tools.
The sooner you get them back,
the sooner I can get back to my research.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
請去浴池把我的研究工具取回來。
你越快取回它們，
我就能越快恢復研究。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Have a safe trip.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
一路平安。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You're back? Where are my research tools?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你回來了？我的研究工具呢？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You still haven't found the research tools?
I'm disappointed. Get yourself to the bath
and quickly retrieve my research tools
taken away from me.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你還沒找到研究工具？
我很失望。快去浴池，
迅速取回被奪走的我的研究工具。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Wow!! You found the research tools...?
You're quite capable.
I really like how you handle your work.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
哇！！你找到了研究工具...？
你很有能力。
我很喜歡你的辦事風格。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I like you.
Do you want to work on my research with me?
I could use your help here and there,
until I'm done with this research.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我喜歡你。
你想和我一起進行這項研究嗎？
在我完成這項研究之前，
我會不時需要你的幫助。

scripts.text: As you wish.
scripts.translation: 遵命。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Great. Thanks, and when we're done,
I'll pay you handsomely.
Also, for every research project that's completed,
I'll also give you some pocket money.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
太好了。謝謝，等我們完成後，
我會給你豐厚的報酬。
另外，每完成一個研究專案，
我也會給你一些零花錢。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Young Raffles these days... they are just plain stupid.
I've always wanted a capable research assistant,
but it hasn't been easy to find one.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
現在的年輕拉弗爾人...簡直太蠢了。
我一直想要一個有能力的研究助手，
但一直很難找到。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
By the way... Was it that difficult to
reclaim the research tools?
You're carrying some very heavy looking equipment.
Go lighten your load, and I'll pay you for your work.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
順便問一下...取回研究工具很難嗎？
你揹著的裝備看起來很重。
去減輕一下負擔吧，我會支付你工作的報酬。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
It must've been hard work to retrieve the tools.
Why don't you take this and go to the inn
and rest up? There's nothing for you to do right now.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
取回工具一定很辛苦吧。
拿著這個去旅館休息一下吧。現在你沒什麼事可做了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
It must've been hard work to retrieve the tools.
Why don't you take this and go to the inn
and rest up? There's nothing for you to do right now.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
取回工具一定很辛苦吧。
拿著這個去旅館休息一下吧。現在你沒什麼事可做了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'm still preparing for the research.
Unfortunately a few research tools
were damaged.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我還在為研究做準備。
不幸的是，有幾件研究工具損壞了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Come to think of it, I don't think
I told you my name.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
說起來，我想我還沒告訴你我的名字。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
My name is Inffle. If anybody
asks you who you are working with,
you can say ^0000FFI'm working with Researcher Inffle.^000000
That's why I'm telling you my name.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我的名字是因弗爾。如果有人問你在和誰一起工作，
你可以說^0000FF我在和研究員因弗爾一起工作。^000000
這就是我告訴你我名字的原因。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Why? The inn is closed?
That's strange, it shouldn't be.
Why don't you go try again?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
為什麼？旅館關門了？
這很奇怪，它不應該關門的。
你再去試試好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Darn, I get more worked up the more I think about it.
It's not like I went with bad intentions...
I just wanted to do some research...
Can't believe I got attacked...
I just can't believe it...
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
該死，越想越氣。
我並沒有帶著惡意去...
我只是想做點研究...
居然被襲擊了...
真是難以置信...
你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Good thing you're here.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
幸好你在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I've been thinking about
the unidentified creature in the bath.
He's quite the little devil, to take research tools,
which are as important to a researcher as his life...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我一直在想那個在浴池裡的不明生物。
它真是個小惡魔，竟然拿走了研究工具，
那些工具對研究員來說可是比命還重要...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
A research assistant's job
is to make sure that the researcher can focus on his research
And not have to worry about anything else... VERY! Important.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
研究助手的職責
就是確保研究員能專心研究，
不用為其他事情分心...非常重要！

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'd like you to take my revenge
on the unidentified creature for me...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我想讓你替我
向那個不明生物復仇...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I don't even want anything that drastic.
3 times! Go bully him for just 3 times.
You can draw on his face,
pinch him, tickle him,
whatever you want. Just bully him 3 times.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我也沒想要那麼極端。
3次！去欺負它3次就好。
你可以在它臉上畫畫，
捏它，撓它，
隨便你。只要欺負它3次就行。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
How's the work going?
An assistant has to work swiftly and effectively.
Could it be that you have forgotten
what your task is?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
工作進展如何？
助手必須迅速且高效地工作。
難道你忘記
你的任務是什麼了嗎？

scripts.text: Exactly. What should I do?
scripts.translation: 沒錯。我該怎麼做？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Go bully the unidentified creature
just 3 times.
You can draw on his face,
pinch him, tickle him, or whatever.
Bully him 3 times.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
去欺負那個不明生物
3次就好。
你可以在它臉上畫畫，
捏它，撓它，或者隨便什麼。
欺負它3次。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
So you taught him a lesson? Great. I feel avenged!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
所以你教訓了它？太好了。我解氣啦！

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
For a while, I couldn't sleep
because I couldn't stop thinking about the lost research tools.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
有一陣子，我因為一直想著丟失的研究工具
而睡不著覺。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
That's that! We need to begin the bath research now.
I need to finish the research quickly,
so that I can start on a new topic.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
好了！我們現在必須開始浴池研究了。
我需要儘快完成研究，
這樣我就可以開始新的課題了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Go to the bath water
with the sample tube that I give you,
and gather some samples.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
拿著我給你的樣本管
去浴池的水裡，
採集一些樣本。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Look around the bath water,
and you will find an area emitting a distinct aura.
You can collect the samples
from that area.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
在浴池的水裡四處看看，
你會發現一個散發著獨特靈氣的區域。
你可以從那個區域
採集樣本。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You are carrying too much weight.
I can't give you the sample tube.
Why don't you lighten your load and come back?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你攜帶的物品太重了。
我無法給你樣本管。
你為什麼不減輕負重再回來呢？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Here is the sample tube for collecting.
Go and collect 10 samples!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
這是用於採集的樣本管。
去採集10個樣本！

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Have you collected the samples yet?
Please hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你採集樣本了嗎？
請快點。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Look around the bath water,
and you will find an area emitting a distinct aura.
You can collect the samples
from that area.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
在浴池的水裡四處看看，
你會發現一個散發著獨特靈氣的區域。
你可以從那個區域
採集樣本。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I know that you've done a lot...
but you are carrying too many things.
Even though I want to give you pocket money, I can't.
Could you lighten your load and come back?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我知道你做了很多事...
但你攜帶的東西太多了。
雖然我想給你零花錢，但我給不了。
你能減輕負重再回來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You got the bath water sample. Great job.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你拿到了三溫暖樣本水。幹得好。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'll have to run a few tests
with the bath water samples.
It usually takes about 24 hours.
Why don't you come back then?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我要用這些三溫暖樣本水做幾項測試。
通常需要大約24小時。
到時候你再回來吧？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
The basic tests have not been completed yet.
There's nothing for you to do now.
Go for a walk.
Spend some money that I gave you.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
基礎測試還沒完成。
現在沒什麼事讓你做。
去散散步吧。
花掉我給你的錢。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
The basic tests are done.
As I thought...
There were many interesting substances in the bath water.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
基礎測試完成了。
果然不出我所料...
浴池的水裡含有許多有趣的物質。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
The most notable is this unidentifiable DNA.
I didn't have a chance to compare it to a lot of DNA samples,
but I'm pretty sure that this DNA
has been transformed by the mysterious substances of the bath.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
最引人注目的是這種無法識別的DNA。
雖然我沒有機會將它與大量DNA樣本進行比對，
但我相當確定這種DNA
是被浴池中神秘物質改造過的。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
After much thought,
I concluded that this DNA probably belongs to
the unidentified creature that attacked me.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
經過深思熟慮，
我得出結論，這種DNA很可能屬於
襲擊過我的那個不明生物。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'd better compare the two.
Please return to the bath
and look for the creature's {0}.
If you can, please bring me 10 of them.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我最好將兩者進行比對。
請回到浴池，
尋找那個不明生物的{0}。
如果可以的話，請給我帶10個回來。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Haven't you found the unidentified creature's {0} yet?
Look carefully!
I'm certain that the creature
dropped his {1} somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你還沒找到不明生物的{0}嗎？
仔細找找！
我確信那個生物
把它的{1}掉落在某處了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You've collected all the {0} samples, finally.
As humans say,
I've been waiting forever for them.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你終於收集齊了所有的{0}樣本。
用人類的話說，
我等它們等得花兒都謝了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I know that you've done a lot...
but you are carrying too many things.
Even though I want to give you pocket money, I can't.
Could you lighten your load and come back?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我知道你做了很多事...
但你攜帶的東西太多了。
雖然我想給你零花錢，但我給不了。
你能減輕負重再回來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
OK, I'll get to work right away.
If you have any business to attend to, do so.
The DNA analysis takes about 6 hours.
Why don't you go for a walk
and come back then?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
好的，我馬上開始工作。
如果你有其他事要辦，就去辦吧。
DNA分析大約需要6小時。
你去散散步，到時候再回來吧？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'm still analyzing the DNA.
The DNA analysis takes about 6 hours.
Why don't you go for a walk and come back then?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我還在分析DNA。
DNA分析大約需要6小時。
你去散散步，到時候再回來吧？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
This is not it.
The samples that you collected belonged to a normal species.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
不是這個。
你收集的樣本屬於普通物種。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Must be because so many species of creatures
have been in the bath.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
一定是因為太多不同種類的生物
都去過浴池。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'm sorry, but please re-collect the samples.
This time, the {0}... Yes.
Please bring the {1} samples.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
很抱歉，請重新採集樣本。
這次，是{0}...是的。
請帶{1}樣本回來。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Great! These samples are surely
from the mysterious creature.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
太好了！這些樣本肯定
來自那個神秘生物。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
According to the analysis,
The DNA is a mutant form of fish DNA.
I'm not sure how long this creature
has lived in the bath,
but this DNA is 70% evolved
from the original fish DNA.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
根據分析結果，
這種DNA是魚類DNA的變異形式。
我不確定這個生物
在浴池裡生活了多久，
但這種DNA已經比原始魚類DNA
進化了70%。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Where did this fish come from?
How can it survive in the warm bath water?
After the DNA analysis,
my head is filled with even more questions.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
這條魚是從哪裡來的？
它怎麼能在這種溫熱的浴池水中生存？
DNA分析結束後，
我腦子裡充滿了更多的問題。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
The village elders say
that the bath water comes from
the puddles around the village.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
村莊的長老們說，
浴池的水來自
村莊周圍的積水坑。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
If you get me a sample from the puddle
to the east, at 2 o'clock from here,
I'll tell you what to do next.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
如果你能給我帶一份
東邊，從這裡看過去2點鐘方向的積水坑樣本，
我會告訴你接下來該怎麼做。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You probably don't need to run around
like you did collecting
the bath water samples.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你大概不需要像採集
浴池水樣本那樣到處跑。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
If you get all 4 puddle samples at once
it may be more convenient. However,
there's the risk of samples being damaged or mixed up.
Therefore, I'm going to send you one place at a time. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
如果你一次性收集齊4份積水坑樣本，
可能會更方便。但是，
樣本有損壞或混淆的風險。
因此，我會讓你一次去一個地方。祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You still haven't gone to collect the puddle sample?
Go to the puddle to the east of the village,
and collect a sample.
It's going to be at 2 o'clock from here.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你還沒去採集積水坑樣本嗎？
去村莊東邊的積水坑，
採集一份樣本。
它位於從這裡看過去的2點鐘方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You have the sample from the puddle to the east?
Great job, but it's no time to rest -
the research is almost done.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你拿到了東邊積水坑的樣本？
幹得好，但現在還不是休息的時候——
研究即將完成。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Get me a sample from the puddle from the west.
It's not completely to the west...
The puddle should be at 7 o'clock
from the village.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
給我一份西邊積水坑的樣本。
不是正西方向...
積水坑應該在
村莊的7點鐘方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Take care not to damage the sample.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
小心別弄壞樣本。
祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You still haven't gone to collect the puddle sample?
Go to the puddle to the west of the village,
and collect a sample.
It's going to be at 7 o'clock from here.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你還沒去採集積水坑樣本嗎？
去村莊西邊的積水坑，
採集一份樣本。
它位於從這裡看過去的7點鐘方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You have the sample from the puddle to the west?
Great job, but it's no time to rest -
the research is almost done.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你拿到了西邊積水坑的樣本？
幹得好，但現在還不是休息的時候——
研究即將完成。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Get me a sample from the puddle from the south.
The puddle to the south
should be... at 6 o'clock from here.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
給我一份南邊積水坑的樣本。
南邊的積水坑
應該在...這裡的6點鐘方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I can't emphasize this enough, even if I did it 1000000000000000000000 times.
Please take care that
the sample is not damaged.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
無論我說多少遍，我都無法強調得足夠。
請確保
樣本沒有損壞。

scripts.text:
You still haven't gone to collect the puddle sample?
Get me a sample from the puddle from the south.
The puddle to the south is located
at 6 o'clock from here.
scripts.translation:
你還沒去採集積水坑樣本嗎？
給我一份南邊積水坑的樣本。
南邊的積水坑位於
這裡的6點鐘方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You know what I'm going to say?
Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你知道我要說什麼嗎？
小心。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You have the sample from the puddle to the south?
Now only the puddle to the north
remains to be sampled.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你拿到了南邊積水坑的樣本？
現在只剩下北邊的積水坑
需要取樣了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Please get me the sample from the puddle to the north.
It's not completely to the north.
it's at 11 o'clock from the village.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
請給我北邊積水坑的樣本。
不是正北方向。
它在村莊的11點鐘方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You know what I'm going to say?
Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你知道我要說什麼嗎？
小心。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You still haven't gone to collect the puddle sample?
Please get me a sample from the puddle to the north.
It's not exactly north of the village.
The puddle should be located at 11 o'clock
from the village.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你還沒去採集積水坑樣本嗎？
請給我北邊積水坑的樣本。
它不在村莊的正北方向。
積水坑應該位於
村莊的11點鐘方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You brought the last sample from the puddle from the north.
Great work. You've done really well.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你帶來了北邊積水坑的最後一份樣本。
幹得漂亮。你做得非常好。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Now, I'm going to do some research
with these samples,
looking at the relationship between
these puddles and the bath.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
現在，我要用這些樣本
做一些研究，
看看這些積水坑
和浴池之間的關係。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I know that you've done a lot...
but you are carrying too many things.
Even though I want to give you pocket money, I can't.
Could you lighten your load and come back?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我知道你做了很多事...
但你攜帶的東西太多了。
雖然我想給你零花錢，但我給不了。
你能減輕負重再回來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
If I finish this experiment...
There's probably nothing else to do. While I run the experiment,
why don't you go and entertain yourself?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
如果我完成這個實驗...
大概就沒有其他事情要做了。在我執行實驗期間，
你不妨去娛樂一下？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Comparison of the samples and the bath water
will take about 12 hours.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
樣本和浴池水的對比
大約需要12小時。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
What? You're here? Well...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
什麼？你在這裡？好吧...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
But the sample studies have not been finished.
This is an experiment for the final result,
so don't be too hasty.
I think the research will take about 12 hours.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
但是樣本研究還沒有完成。
這是為了最終結果的實驗，
所以不要太著急。
我認為研究大約需要12小時。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Come back then.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
那就回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You're here? Finally,
the experiment results are all in.
Do you want to look at the results?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你來了？終於，
實驗結果都出來了。
你想看看結果嗎？

scripts.text: Actually, I don't want to.
scripts.translation: 其實，我不想看。

scripts.text: Look at the results.
scripts.translation: 看看結果。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Good thinking. Actually, it may hurt
regular people's brains to look at it.
I suppose it's time for your reward
for helping me out so much.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
想得很周到。其實，
看這個可能會傷害普通人的大腦。
我想是時候給你獎勵了，
畢竟你幫了我這麼多。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Did I talk to you about the reward before the experiment?
That you won't be sorry that you helped out...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我在實驗前跟你說過獎勵的事嗎？
說你幫忙後不會後悔...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You're curious about the results? Really???
OK, here it is.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
你對結果很好奇？真的？？？
好吧，給你看。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
There are no volcanoes around the area
and no record of volcanoes in the past,
but the water temperature is that high...
Isn't it surprising?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
這一帶沒有火山，
過去也沒有火山的記錄，
但水溫卻這麼高...
是不是很驚訝？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
The ingredients are... yes.
There are certainly substances that are beneficial for you humans.
But, there are also substances
that are fatal to us Raffles,
or other races.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
成分嘛...是的。
確實有一些對你們人類有益的物質。
但也有些物質
對我們拉弗爾斯，
或其他種族是致命的。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
And if you look at the electric conductivity,
it is quite higher than that of the average water.
My theory is that
this must be the cause of the mysterious power.
That's what I'm thinking about.
Anyhow.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
而且看電導率，
比普通水高得多。
我的理論是，
這一定是神秘力量的原因。
我是這麼想的。
總之。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
There is something at work that science cannot explain
in the bath water...
Take the unidentified creature, for instance.
How strange is it that a fish can live
in such warm water?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
浴池的水裡
有科學無法解釋的東西在起作用...
比如那個不明生物。
魚能在這麼熱的水裡生存，
是不是很奇怪？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'm not satisfied with the research results and conclusions.
I guess in the end,
it will remain a mystery...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我對研究結果和結論並不滿意。
我想最終，
它仍會是一個謎...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I suppose it's time for your reward
for helping me out so much.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我想是時候給你獎勵了，
畢竟你幫了我這麼多。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Did I talk to you about the reward before the experiment?
That you won't be sorry that you helped out...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我在實驗前跟你說過獎勵的事嗎？
說你幫忙後不會後悔...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I was thinking about what you would want
for your reward... and I felt
a little... sad.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我在想你會想要什麼作為獎勵...
然後我感到
有點...難過。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
... ... ... ...

[Raffle Researcher]
During our short time here together working on these projects,
I sent you all over the place.
It must've been hard, but you didn't complain at all.
And unlike some of the other guys I've had,
you never skipped work.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
在我們一起工作的這段時間裡，
我派你到處跑。
一定很辛苦，但你從未抱怨。
而且不像我遇到的其他人，
你從未缺勤。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I suppose I've grown fond of you,
so that it saddens me to say goodbye...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我想我已經對你產生了感情，
所以要說再見讓我很難過...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
But thank you anyhow. I've been researching for a while,
but I've never met such an excellent research assistant as you.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
但無論如何，謝謝你。我研究了一段時間，
但從未遇到過像你這樣優秀的研究助手。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Hmm? By the way...
You are carrying too much weight.
Could it be because you are also sad
about parting ways?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
嗯？順便問一下...
你攜帶的東西太多了。
難道是因為
你也為分別感到難過嗎？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
With this weight, I can't give you a reward!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
帶著這麼重的東西，我沒法給你獎勵！

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
The best research assistant in my life...
is you, {0}!!!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我這一生中遇到的
最優秀的研究助手...
就是你，{0}！！！

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
If we happen to run into each other again,
let's work on a research project once more.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
如果我們再次相遇，
希望能再一起進行研究工作。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Hmm? No?... What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
嗯？沒有嗎？...那你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Could it be that you suddenly want to look at
the research report???
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
難道你是突然想看看
研究報告？？？

scripts.text: Look at the report.
scripts.translation: 看看報告

scripts.text: I came to say hello.
scripts.translation: 我來打個招呼。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Haven't I shown it to you before?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我之前不是給你看過嗎？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
... ... ... ...

[Raffle Researcher]
Maybe I haven't shown you.
Sorry about that. So you wanted to see it so badly
that you came back to see me?
Great! Here it is.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
也許我還沒給你看過。
抱歉。原來你是這麼想看，
才特意回來找我的嗎？
太好了！給你。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
This concludes the report of
Mora Village's mysterious bath.
You want to look again?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
這就是關於穆拉村神秘溫泉的報告。
你想再看一遍嗎？

scripts.text: Look again.
scripts.translation: 再看一遍

scripts.text: Don't look again.
scripts.translation: 不看了

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Sure... As you wish!!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
好吧...如你所願！！

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Goodbye. Come by any time,
if you want to look at the results again.
You're always welcome here.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
再見。如果你想再看結果，
隨時歡迎過來。
這裡永遠歡迎你。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Oh, You came to say hi. I see.
Long time no see, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
哦，你是來打招呼的。原來如此。
好久不見，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I've been telling you that I lucked out in picking you as my research assistant.
Come by any time,
if you want to look at the results again.
You're always welcome here.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾研究員]
我一直都在說，選中你當我的研究助手真是我的幸運。
如果你想再看結果，
隨時歡迎過來。
這裡永遠歡迎你。

Who are you?
scripts.translation:

嗯？我是研究員因弗爾。
你是誰？

You good. Good!
scripts.translation:
[小魚]
你很好。很好！

Me didn't live here.
Me lived puddle.
Puddle. Live there.
scripts.translation:
[小魚]
我不住這裡。
我住水坑。
水坑。住那裡。

scripts.text:
[Fishee]
Me sleep weird.
Wake up one day.
Here, bath.
scripts.translation:
[小魚]
我睡覺很奇怪。
有一天醒來。
在這裡，洗澡。

scripts.text:

Don't know how go home.
Me just live here.
Grow big. Hole small.
Can't get in.
scripts.translation:
[小魚]
不知道怎麼回家。
我就住這裡。
長大了。洞變小了。
進不去了。

Me miss family. Me want to see family.

Bring me. Good.
scripts.translation:

我想家人。我想見家人。
你很好。我家人怎麼樣了。
帶我去。很好。

scripts.text: How would I know who is your family?
scripts.translation: 我怎麼知道誰是你的家人？

scripts.text:
[Fishee]
Us fish stupid.
Stupid. But know family name.
scripts.translation:
[小魚]
我們魚很笨。
笨。但知道家人名字。

scripts.text:
[Fishee]
Family know name Fishee. Family come.
scripts.translation:
[小魚]
家人知道我叫小魚。家人會來。

Please. In puddle.

scripts.text:

Please. In puddle.
You tell me my family do okay.
scripts.translation:
[小魚]
拜託。在水坑裡。
你告訴我我家人好不好。

scripts.text:
[Fishee]
You forgot me name?

[小魚]
你忘記我名字了？

scripts.text: I know your name.

Your memory, like fish.

My name Fishee, Fishee!!
scripts.translation:

你的記憶，像魚一樣。
笨。我說話。
我叫小魚，小魚！！

scripts.text:

Please. In puddle.
You tell me my family do okay.
scripts.translation:
[小魚]
拜託。在水坑裡。
你告訴我我家人好不好。

scripts.text:

You have lots.
I give. To you.
Empty bag. Come back.

你有很多。
我給了。給你。
空袋子。回來。

Re... Don't know word.

你告訴我我家人很好。謝謝你。

謝...不知道那個詞。

scripts.translation: 也許...獎勵？

[Fishee]
Yes. That. You good.
Smart. Give you reward.
I know thank you. Fish.
scripts.translation:
[小魚]
是的。那個。你很好。
很聰明。給你獎勵。
我知道謝謝你。魚。

This, I got from bath.
No. Someone left it.
... ... Good guy. I give you.

這個，我從水坑裡撿到的。
不。是別人留下的。

你... 名字？

{0} 做。

誰.. 你... 是？

[象牙]
