scripts.translation:
[霍查]
如果你任務日誌中有未完成的任務，它們將被視為“失敗”並從日誌中移除。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
Once they are removed, go talk to Elephantine and you can receive new tasks.
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
移除後，去找象牙談談，你就可以接新任務了。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
Welcome.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
歡迎光臨。
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: I have completed a task.
scripts.translation: 我已完成任務。

scripts.text:
Oh.
Have you?
Please wait a minute while I check the documents.
scripts.translation:
哦。
是嗎？
請稍等，我查一下檔案。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
Yes, I see you've completed the task. It has been confirmed as completed.
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
是的，我看到你已完成任務。已確認任務完成。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
Hmm... {0}.
It may be a documentation error, but according to the documents, you have nothing to do with the tasks.
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
嗯... {0}。
這可能是檔案記錄有誤，但根據檔案顯示，你並沒有參與任何任務。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多了，無法進行該操作。請丟棄一些物品後再試。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的重量太重了，無法進行該操作。請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
I try to give tasks only to reliable people. You are......... no, never mind.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
我只會把任務交給可靠的人。你嘛...算了，不說了。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
You really have no clue. What could you do with such a weak body?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
你完全不懂。就你那弱小的身體，能做什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
I have no additional tasks available now. If I get some, I'll let you know when you come back.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
我現在沒有額外的任務。如果有的話，等你回來時我會通知你。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Will you please check with the ^990099General Goods Dealer^000000
on the details of the previous task?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
請向^990099雜貨商^000000確認一下之前任務的細節。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Welcome.
I have some tasks for you - will you take a look at them?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
歡迎光臨。
我有一些任務給你——要看看嗎？

scripts.text: What kind of tasks do you have for me?
scripts.translation: 你有什麼任務給我？

scripts.text: Tell me about today's task.
scripts.translation: 告訴我今天的任務。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Here, we make all kinds of supplies for adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
在這裡，我們為冒險者製作各種補給品。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
We accept raw materials for the supplies once a day.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
我們每天接收一次用於製作補給品的原材料。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Sometimes, we might ask for materials that are very difficult to obtain. In that case, try to get help from your fellow adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
有時候，我們可能會要求非常難以獲得的材料。在這種情況下，請嘗試向其他冒險者尋求幫助。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Let me see... what supplies are we making today...?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
讓我看看...今天我們要製作什麼補給品...？

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
How about this one?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
這個怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
The adventurers here make sure to bring with them, on their exploration to dungeons, a preservative to keep their food fresh. Do you know what the preservative is made from?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
這裡的冒險者在探索地下城時，通常會隨身攜帶一種防腐劑來保持食物新鮮。你知道這種防腐劑是用什麼做的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
*grin* None other than... Insect Feelers! The General Goods Dealer there asked me to get four of them. I personally would not eat it for all the world...
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
*咧嘴笑* 不是別的，正是...昆蟲觸角！那邊的雜貨商讓我去弄四個。我個人就算給再多錢也不會吃這個...

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
These days, it's common for adventurers here to make talismans to protect themselves on their dangerous adventures. Like a kind of insurance.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
最近，這裡的冒險者通常會製作護身符來保護自己在危險冒險中的安全。就像一種保險一樣。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Immortal Hearts seem to be all the rage lately. The General Goods Merchant asked me to get five of them.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
不死心臟最近似乎很流行。雜貨商讓我去弄五個。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
They need tons of Rotten Bandages for making first aid bandages. They must have run out of new materials.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
他們需要大量的腐爛繃帶來製作急救繃帶。他們一定用完了新材料。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
The client is the General Goods Merchant over there. Three bunches of them will be enough.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
客戶是那邊的雜貨商。三束就足夠了。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Symbols of strong warriors give adventurers great support on their journeys. That's why Orcish Vouchers sell like hotcakes.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
強大戰士的象徵能給冒險者在旅途中提供巨大的支援。這就是為什麼獸人戰士之證如此暢銷。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
The General Goods Dealer asked me to get three Orcish Vouchers, which are to be used to make symbols of courage.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
雜貨商讓我去弄三個獸人戰士之證，用來製作勇氣的象徵。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
It seems to be rumored among adventurers that drinking powdered bones mixed with water helps boost their stamina.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
聽說冒險者之間流傳著一種說法：將骨頭磨成粉泡水喝，有助於提升體力。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
The General Goods Dealer asked me to get three Skel-Bones, which are to be used to make tonic.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
雜貨商讓我去弄三根骷髏骨，用來製作補品。

scripts.text: You have received the task ^880088{0}^000000. Open and see the quest window for the details.
scripts.translation: 您已接取任務 ^880088{0}^000000。請開啟任務視窗檢視詳情。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多了，無法進行該操作。請丟棄一些物品後再試。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的重量太重了，無法進行該操作。請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
Hmm, you don't look reliable enough for Bow-wow's tasks.
scripts.translation:
[雜貨商]
嗯，你看起來不夠可靠，不適合接汪汪的任務。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
What could you do with that fragile body? Go get some exercise.
scripts.translation:
[雜貨商]
你那副弱不禁風的樣子能做什麼？去鍛鍊鍛鍊吧。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
I see you haven't received
any tasks yet.
Go talk to Bow-wow,
and Bow-wow will give you
one of the countless tasks.
scripts.translation:
[雜貨商]
看來你還沒接取任何任務。
去找汪汪談談吧，
他會從無數任務中給你分配一個。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
The time is up to complete the existing tasks.
scripts.translation:
[雜貨商]
完成現有任務的時間到了。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
If you have any unfinished tasks in your quest log, they are considered 'failed' and removed from the log.
scripts.translation:
[雜貨商]
如果你任務日誌中有未完成的任務，它們將被視為“失敗”並從日誌中移除。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
Once they are removed, go talk to Bow-wow and you can receive new tasks.
scripts.translation:
[雜貨商]
移除後，去找汪汪談談，你就可以接取新任務了。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
Welcome.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[雜貨商]
歡迎光臨。
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: I have completed a task.
scripts.translation: 我已完成任務。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
Oh.
Have you?
Please wait a minute while I check the documents.
scripts.translation:
[雜貨商]
哦。
是嗎？
請稍等，我查一下檔案。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
Hmm... {0}.
It may be a documentation error, but according to the documents, you have nothing to do with the tasks.
scripts.translation:
[雜貨商]
嗯... {0}。
可能是檔案記錄有誤，但根據記錄，你與這些任務無關。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
The amount is not enough...
scripts.translation:
[雜貨商]
數量不夠...

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
I've received the items all right. It will be some time before I have another task for you, so why don't you visit the hot spring and relax?
scripts.translation:
[雜貨商]
物品已收到。接下來要過段時間才有新任務給你，不如去溫泉放鬆一下？

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多了，無法進行該操作。請丟棄一些物品後再試。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的重量太重了，無法進行該操作。請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Can you please keep away from me? You're getting in the way.
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
請離我遠點？你擋路了。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
This place is not a nursery. Grow up and come back, and I'll gladly give you tasks.
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
這裡不是托兒所。長大點再來，我會樂意給你任務的。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
I have no additional tasks available now. If I get some, I'll let you know when you come back.
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
我現在沒有額外的任務。如果有的話，等你回來時我會通知你。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Will you please check with the ^990099Commodities Dealer^000000, standing across from me,
on the details of the previous task?
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
請去對面站著的^990099日用品商人^000000那裡，確認一下上一個任務的詳情。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Nice to see you.
I have some tasks for you - will you take a look at them?
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
很高興見到你。
我有一些任務給你——你要看看嗎？

scripts.text: What kind of tasks do you have for me?
scripts.translation: 你有什麼任務給我？

scripts.text: Tell me about today's task.
scripts.translation: 告訴我今天的任務。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Bow-wow and I are in the same industry.
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
汪汪和我屬於同一個行業。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
We are a manufacturer of adventurers' supplies.
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
我們是冒險者用品的製造商。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
My tasks won't be easy - you'd better prepare yourself.
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
我的任務可不容易——你最好做好準備。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Hmm... What tasks are at hand today?
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
嗯... 今天手頭有什麼任務呢？

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Oh. This one looks good.
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
哦。這個看起來不錯。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Some people just hang their talismans around their necks, but more people choose to seal them in special cases and carry them on their bodies.
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
有些人只是把護身符掛在脖子上，但更多人選擇把它們封存在特殊的盒子裡，隨身攜帶。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Mementos serve as inspirations for designers of those cases. The Commodities Dealer across from me asked me to get two of them.
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
紀念品可以作為這些盒子設計師的靈感。對面的日用品商人讓我去拿兩個。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Adventurers make sure to keep their talismans safe, because they could save their lives.
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
冒險者會確保護身符的安全，因為它們可能會救命。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
The Commodities Dealer across from me seems to make protective cases out of Shells. I was asked to get three of them.
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
對面的日用品商人似乎用貝殼製作保護盒。我被要求去拿三個。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Adventurers that go into the bushes of the Maze of the Hazy Forest always wear knee protectors.
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
進入迷霧森林迷宮灌木叢的冒險者總是佩戴護膝。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
The Commodities Dealer across from me asked me to get three Scale Shells, which are to be used to make knee protectors.
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
對面的日用品商人讓我去拿三個鱗片皮膚，用來製作護膝。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
I have a task for you at hand, making a vaccine for possible poisonous insects.
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
我手頭有一個任務，為可能的有毒昆蟲製作疫苗。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
The Commodities Dealer across from me asked me to get two Venom Canines, which are to be used in the research of the substance.
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
對面的日用品商人讓我去拿兩個毒牙，用於研究該物質。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
It seems they have run out of the material for adding non-slip soles to shoes.
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
看來給長靴新增防滑鞋底的材料用完了。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
The Commodities Dealer across from me commissioned me to get five globs of Sticky Mucus.
scripts.translation:
[嗚汪]
對面的日用品商人委託我去拿五團粘稠液體。

scripts.text: You have received the task ^880088{0}^000000. Open and see the quest window for the details.
scripts.translation: 您已接取任務 ^880088{0}^000000。請開啟任務視窗檢視詳情。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多了，無法進行該操作。請丟棄一些物品後再試。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的重量太重了，無法進行該操作。請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
Well, Woof-grrr can't have given a weakling like you tasks.
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
哼，嗚汪不可能給你這種弱者分配任務。

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
Go away! I can't concentrate on cataloging with you hanging around like that...
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
走開！你這樣在旁邊晃悠，我沒法專心整理目錄...

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
I see you haven't received
any tasks yet.
Go talk to Woof-grrr,
and Woof-grrr will give you
one of the countless tasks.
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
看來你還沒接到任何任務。
去和嗚汪談談，
他會給你分配無數任務中的一個。

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
The time is up to complete the existing tasks.
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
完成現有任務的時間到了。

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
If you have any unfinished tasks in your quest log, they are considered 'failed' and removed from the log.
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
如果你的任務日誌中有未完成的任務，它們將被視為“失敗”並從日誌中移除。

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
Once they are removed, go talk to Woof-grrr and you can receive new tasks.
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
移除後，去找嗚汪談談，你就能接取新任務了。

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
Welcome.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
歡迎光臨。
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: I have completed a task.
scripts.translation: 我已完成任務。

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
Oh.
Have you?
Please wait a minute while I check the documents.
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
哦。
是嗎？
請稍等，我查一下檔案。

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
Hmm... {0}.
It may be a documentation error, but according to the documents, you have nothing to do with the tasks.
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
嗯... {0}。
可能是檔案記錄有誤，但根據記錄，您並沒有參與這些任務。

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
The amount is not enough...
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
數量不足...

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
I've received the items all right. I look forward to working with you again.
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
物品已收到。期待與您再次合作。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多了，無法進行該操作。請丟棄一些物品後再試。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的重量太重了，無法進行該操作。請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text:
[Soul Guide]
Reliability is the primary quality needed in looking for lost souls. You don't look so reliable to me.
scripts.translation:
[靈魂嚮導]
尋找迷失的靈魂，首要品質是可靠。在我看來，你似乎並不夠可靠。

scripts.text:
[Soul Guide]
You need to have a strong spirit to do this task. I think you need a lot more discipline.
scripts.translation:
[靈魂嚮導]
執行這項任務需要強大的精神力。我覺得你需要更多的自律。

scripts.text: You still have marks of the haunting souls on your body.
scripts.translation: 你身上還殘留著遊蕩靈魂的印記。

scripts.text: You'll have to come back when the marks have disappeared.
scripts.translation: 等印記消失後，你再回來吧。

scripts.text: You feel your mind has calmed down once again. You now have enough energy to go look for other souls, so talk to the Guide again.
scripts.translation: 你感到心境再次平靜下來。現在你有足夠的精力去尋找其他靈魂了，請再次與嚮導交談。

scripts.text:
[Soul Guide]
Welcome.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[靈魂嚮導]
歡迎光臨。
你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: What kind of tasks do you have for me?
scripts.translation: 你有什麼任務給我？

scripts.text: Tell me about today's task.
scripts.translation: 告訴我今天的任務。

scripts.text:
[Soul Guide]
My job is to gather the remains of the souls haunting the forest and put them to rest.
scripts.translation:
[靈魂嚮導]
我的工作是收集在森林中游蕩的靈魂殘骸，並讓它們安息。

scripts.text:
[Soul Guide]
There are countless souls trapped in the Maze.
scripts.translation:
[靈魂嚮導]
迷宮中困著無數靈魂。

scripts.text:
[Soul Guide]
Help them get their long-deserved rest.
scripts.translation:
[靈魂嚮導]
幫助它們獲得久違的安息。

scripts.text:
[Soul Guide]
I'll show you the details of one of the lost souls.
scripts.translation:
[靈魂嚮導]
我會向你展示其中一個迷失靈魂的詳細情況。

scripts.text: ^660066Age 32. Comes from Midgard. Has been missing for 3 months since he went to the Maze of the Hazy Forest in order to collect the native plants. Low chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066年齡32歲。來自米德加爾特。3個月前進入迷霧森林迷宮採集原生植物後失蹤。生還機率極低。^000000

scripts.text:
^660066Age 19. Adventurer who came from a far, unknown place by ship. Been missing for 2 months since he went to explore the Maze dressed in thin tights, despite dissuasion of all Mora residents.
Even if he's alive, he would cause trouble to the rescue team.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660066年齡19歲。來自遙遠未知之地的冒險者，乘船而來。2個月前不顧穆拉居民的勸阻，身穿緊身衣進入迷宮探索後失蹤。
即使他還活著，也會給救援隊帶來麻煩。^000000

scripts.text:
^660066Age unknown. Has some mental illness. Went alone in order to purify the Maze of the Hazy forest. He insists that he has good ancestry but no one trusts him.
Disappearance period : 12 years. Not much chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660066年齡不詳。患有某種精神疾病。獨自進入迷霧森林迷宮，聲稱要淨化迷宮。他堅稱自己出身名門，但沒人相信他。
失蹤時間：12年。生還機率極低。^000000

scripts.text:
^660066Age 51. Used to be a big thief who stole famous swords from all around the world.
Went missing in the Maze after being pursued for running an illegal casino house which caused massive casualties in his final years. Low chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660066年齡51歲。曾是著名的大盜賊，從世界各地偷竊名劍。
晚年因經營非法賭場導致重大傷亡而被追捕，隨後在迷宮中失蹤。生還機率極低。^000000

scripts.text:
^660066Age 22. An apprentice of an airship pilot. He has gone missing while drinking in Mora town, where he went for a break.
Rumor has it that he fled after signing somewhere. Disappearance period : 4 months. Low chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660066年齡22歲。飛空艇飛行員的學徒。為了休假前往穆拉鎮，卻在飲酒時失蹤。
傳聞他在某處簽了字後逃跑了。失蹤時間：4個月。生還機率極低。^000000

scripts.text: ^660066Age Unknown. A female with long hair, dressed in black. Went on an expedition to the forest of the Maze in search of eternal life. Disappearance period : 3 months. Low chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066年齡不詳。長髮女性，身穿黑衣。為了尋找永生而進入迷霧森林迷宮探險。失蹤時間：3個月。生還機率極低。^000000

scripts.text: ^660066Age around 50. The current Mayor of the Mora village. He ran away to the Forest of Maze after being caught pocketing profits by cheating the residents. Survival uncertain.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066年齡約50歲。現任穆拉村村長。因被揭發通過欺騙村民中飽私囊而逃往迷霧森林迷宮。生死不明。^000000

scripts.text:
^660066Age 29. A young man with an unknown background.
Fled to the forest of maze after scamming 1200 Mora coins from Mora residents while pretending to start a lot of business and adapting himself in Mora. Survival uncertain.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660066年齡29歲。背景不明的年輕男子。
在穆拉定居並假裝創業，騙取了村民1200枚穆拉村硬幣後逃往迷霧森林迷宮。生死不明。^000000

scripts.text: ^660066Age 34. Flirted with several women in Mora. Fled from Mora villagers to the forest of maze. Survival uncertain.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066年齡34歲。在穆拉與多名女性調情。被穆拉村民追趕後逃往迷霧森林迷宮。生死不明。^000000

scripts.text: ^660066Age Unknown. Disappered with coins which were joint controlled by the villagers. Low chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066年齡不詳。帶著由村民共同管理的硬幣失蹤。生還機率極低。^000000

scripts.text: ^990099Information on missing person {0}^000000 has been found. Check your Quest Window for further information.
scripts.translation: ^990099已找到失蹤者{0}^000000的資訊。請檢視任務視窗以獲取詳細資訊。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Customer]
I don't know whether to believe this art dealer... He made me stand here like this for days.... Ah... I feel dizzy.
scripts.translation:
[閒逛的顧客]
我不知道該不該相信這個藝術品商人...他讓我在這裡站了好幾天...啊...我覺得頭暈。

scripts.text:
[Naive Customer]
I don't know when carving my pendant will be completed. Since he is a reliable art dealer, I suppose he won't break my pendant.
scripts.translation:
[天真的顧客]
我不知道我的吊墜什麼時候能雕刻完成。既然他是位可靠的藝術品商人，我想他不會弄壞我的吊墜。

scripts.text:
[Victim]
You Bastard! I want my rugged outwear! That was passed on to me by my father *SOB*
scripts.translation:
[受害者]
你這個混蛋！把我的粗呢外套還給我！那是我父親傳給我的 *抽泣*

scripts.text: ^990099 It seems that he has gotten a great deal of damage from the art dealer.^000000
scripts.translation: ^990099 看來他被那個藝術品商人坑得很慘。^000000

scripts.text:
Enter your password
Hehe
scripts.translation:
請輸入密碼
嘿嘿

scripts.text:
Enter your password
[Initialization]
14.1 Initializing all quest window include related daily quest and map and so on
scripts.translation:
請輸入密碼
[初始化]
14.1 正在初始化所有任務視窗，包括相關日常任務、地圖等

scripts.text: You have to make space in your inventory.
scripts.translation: 你需要在物品欄中騰出空間。

scripts.text: These must be [{0}]'s Remains. So carefully gather his remains.
scripts.translation: 這一定是[{0}]的遺骸。請小心地收集他的遺骸。

scripts.text: You picked up {0} Mora Coins next to the remains.
scripts.translation: 你在遺骸旁邊撿到了{0}枚穆拉村硬幣。

scripts.text: You see traces of recent digging.
scripts.translation: 你看到了最近挖掘的痕跡。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Chief]
We are the legendary order of the Neighborhood Knights, founded just five minutes ago!
scripts.translation:
[騎士團長]
我們是傳奇的鄰里騎士團，就在五分鐘前成立的！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Chief]
We have four chiefs but no foot soldiers...
It's so frustrating!
scripts.translation:
[騎士團長]
我們有四位首領，卻沒有一個士兵...
真是令人沮喪！

scripts.text:
[Other Leaders]
Those other guys are all soldiers, but I'm the Boss!
I, the Head, will tell you what to do!
The Leader is the highest in the rank!
You talked me into joining the order, and now look at this!
scripts.translation:
[其他首領]
那些傢伙都是士兵，但我才是老闆！
我，作為頭目，會告訴你們該怎麼做！
首領是等級最高的！
是你勸我加入騎士團的，現在看看這是什麼樣子！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
We've run out of Mora Coins.
Come back tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[騎士團首領]
我們的穆拉村硬幣已經用完了。
明天再來吧！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
You have a lot of things with you!
Why not dump some of them in my pocket?
scripts.translation:
[騎士團首領]
你身上帶的東西真多啊！
不如把一些放進我的口袋裡？

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
So you've brought back
200 ^FF0000Mysterious Seeds^000000.
Are you working under my command?
I'm so confused
because I've been sending random people on errands.
scripts.translation:
[騎士團首領]
看來你帶回了200 ^FF0000神奇種子^000000。
你是在我的指揮下工作的嗎？
我有點糊塗了，
因為我一直在派隨機的人去跑腿。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
I'll reward you as I promised.
You made sure everyone knows
it's the Order of the Neighborhood Knights's work, right?
scripts.translation:
[騎士團首領]
我會兌現承諾獎勵你的。
你肯定讓大家都知道
這是鄰里騎士團的功勞，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
You have courage to
show up out of nowhere
and demand Mora Coins... how impressive!
You're more than qualified to be a soldier of the Order of the Neighborhood Knights.
scripts.translation:
[騎士團首領]
你竟然敢憑空出現
索要穆拉村硬幣...真是令人印象深刻！
你完全有資格成為鄰里騎士團計程車兵。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
Soldier, I need you to do something for me.
Go to the Hazy Forest and gather 200 ^FF0000Mysterious Seeds^000000!
scripts.translation:
[騎士團首領]
士兵，我需要你幫我做件事。
去迷霧森林收集200 ^FF0000神奇種子^000000！

scripts.text: Yes, sir!
scripts.translation: 是的，長官！

scripts.text: I challenge you to a duel!
scripts.translation: 我要向你發起決鬥！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
Good attitude, {0} Soldier!
I'll reward you handsomely when you get back.
scripts.translation:
[騎士團首領]
態度不錯，{0}士兵！
等你回來我會好好獎勵你的。

scripts.text:
[Other Bosses]
This is from me, the Chief!
Don't look down on the Head!
It's from me, the Leader!
scripts.translation:
[其他首領]
這是我，首領的命令！
別看不起頭目！
這是我，首領的決定！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
See the Chief if you want to have a duel!
I'm in charge of recruiting here.
Ahem...
scripts.translation:
[騎士團首領]
想決鬥的話去找首領！
我負責這裡的招募工作。
咳咳...

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
You have a lot of things with you!
Why not dump some of them in my pocket?
scripts.translation:
[騎士團團長]
你身上帶的東西真多啊！
不如把一些放進我的口袋裡？

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
I hear that a Laphine called 'Lope'
went missing in the Hazy Forest.
I wish the Order of the Neighborhood Knights
scripts.translation:
[騎士團團長]
我聽說一隻名叫“洛佩”的拉芬
在迷霧森林失蹤了。
我希望鄰里騎士團

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
could help solve the case,
but we can't now
because we're not done cleaning the yard yet.
So, what I'm trying to say is
scripts.translation:
[騎士團團長]
能幫忙破案，
但現在不行，
因為我們還沒打掃完院子。
所以，我想說的是

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
why don't you go
and deal with the problem
on behalf of the Order of the Neighborhood Knights!
scripts.translation:
[騎士團團長]
你為什麼不替鄰里騎士團
去處理這個問題呢！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
I promise, as the Head of the Order,
that I'll give you more work
when you get back!
scripts.translation:
[騎士團團長]
我作為團長向你保證，
等你回來我會給你更多工作！

scripts.text:
[Other Heads]
I approve it, as the Chief.
You can thank me, the Boss.
You know the Leader is the boss here, right?
scripts.translation:
[其他首領]
我，首領，批准了。
你可以感謝我，老闆。
你知道首領才是這裡的老闆，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
So the missing Laphine
is dead?
I'm sorry to hear that.
I could have saved him.
scripts.translation:
[騎士團團長]
所以那隻失蹤的拉芬
死了嗎？
聽到這個訊息我很遺憾。
我本可以救他的。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
I hear that there are more ^0000FFLope's Clues^000000
in the Hazy Forest.
Go look for the rest of them
and bring back about 30 of them.
They will make great souvenirs.
scripts.translation:
[騎士團團長]
我聽說迷霧森林裡還有更多 ^0000FF洛佩之線索^000000。
去找找剩下的，
帶回來大約30個。
它們會成為很好的紀念品。

scripts.text: Am I doing all the work here or what?
scripts.translation: 難道只有我在幹活嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, sir!
scripts.translation: 是的，長官！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
So you've noticed it?
Darn! I should have given you work earlier!
scripts.translation:
[騎士團團長]
原來你注意到了？
該死！我早該給你派活了！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
It was worthwhile to have trained you after all.
I'm proud of you,{0} Soldier!
scripts.translation:
[騎士團團長]
看來訓練你是值得的。
我很為你感到驕傲，{0}士兵！

scripts.text:
[Other Heads]
I think you'll make a great right-hand man, the Chief.
I feel rewarded, as the Boss.
As the Leader, I'm so pleased to see you all improve.
scripts.translation:
[其他首領]
我覺得你會成為首領的得力助手。
作為老闆，我感到很欣慰。
作為領袖，看到你們進步我真的很高興。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
You still haven't gathered
^0000FFLope's Clues^000000?
I feel somewhat good,
because that's about what I expected out of you.
scripts.translation:
[騎士團團長]
你還沒收集到 ^0000FF洛佩之線索^000000 嗎？
我有點放心，
因為這就是我對你的預期。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
So you've brought back ^0000FFLope's Clues^000000.
Let's see ...
Assemble, assemble
Attach, attach
scripts.translation:
[騎士團團長]
所以你帶回了 ^0000FF洛佩之線索^000000。
讓我看看...
組裝，組裝
連線，連線

scripts.text:
[Lope's Letter]
...a traveler... attacked...
...under disguise... deadly poison...
...the Village... in danger...
scripts.translation:
[洛佩的信]
...一個旅行者...襲擊了...
...戴著假面...致命猛毒...
...村莊...陷入危險...

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
What on earth does this mean?
Well done, anyway.
Cheer up, you will be a great head of the Knights like myself, someday.
scripts.translation:
[騎士團團長]
這到底是什麼意思？
不管怎樣，幹得好。
振作起來，總有一天你會像我一樣成為偉大的騎士團團長。

scripts.text:
[Other Heads]
I'm not so sure!
It's too much for us.
It's no use trying to do it.
scripts.translation:
[其他首領]
我不這麼認為！
這對我們來說太難了。
嘗試也是徒勞的。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
We're in trouble.
We're sick of being knights.
We're thinking of forming
a circus troupe instead.
Are you interested in trying tightrope walking?
scripts.translation:
[騎士團團長]
我們遇到麻煩了。
我們受夠了當騎士。
我們在考慮改組馬戲團。
你有興趣試試走鋼絲嗎？

scripts.text: Well, I could do a fire show.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我可以表演火舞。

scripts.text: This is so absurd.
scripts.translation: 這太荒謬了。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
No, it's impossible.
I burned down a few houses
playing with fire.
scripts.translation:
[騎士團團長]
不，那是不可能的。
我玩火的時候燒掉了幾棟房子。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
That's the answer I expected.
I'm proud of myself.
scripts.translation:
[騎士團團長]
這就是我想聽到的答案。
我真為自己感到驕傲。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Leader]
I'm the Leader of the Order -
you can tell me.
What brings you here? Do you have some work for us?
scripts.translation:
[騎士團團長]
我是騎士團的領袖——
你可以告訴我。
什麼事把你帶到這裡？你有工作要交給我們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Other Leaders]
Huh! I said the Boss is the boss!
No, the Chief is the best!
How rude you all are! I'm the Head here!
scripts.translation:
[其他首領]
哼！我說老闆就是老闆！
不，首領才是最好的！
你們真沒禮貌！這裡我是團長！
